system.description:
Favoured weapon: Flail, Heavy

Granted power: During a storm or rain, the first creature you hit each round with any attack (weapon or spell) is pushed 10ft and makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or falls Prone. Once/day: call a lightning strike (3d6, Reflex save for half).

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Akadi in the World of Arneyan wiki.
